desc: Build the trie with node counts, depths, children, and terminal occurrence index lists for each original word index.
Use iterative DFS to assign consecutive positions to word occurrences and compute each node's subtree interval [left, right].
Compute global_best_gt as the maximum depth of any node with count > k, and collect intervals for all nodes with count == k.
Use two sweeps with start/end maxima to compute for each occurrence position the maximum depth among count==k intervals that do not contain it.
Combine global_best_gt and outside-interval maxima into the answer for each original index, handling len(words) - 1 < k by returning zeros.
Validate the implementation on the provided examples and edge cases: k = 1, k = len(words), duplicate words, prefix words, terminal nodes with descendants, and no common prefix.
